sql_queries.sql_query:
SELECT 
  CASE WHEN sum("ta_1"."AMOUNT") IS NOT NULL THEN sum("ta_1"."AMOUNT") ELSE 0 END "ca_1"
FROM "ANALYTICS"."PUBLIC"."FCT_ORDERS" "ta_1"
WHERE "ta_1"."REGION" IN ('EMEA', 'AMER')

SELECT 
  DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', "ta_1"."ORDER_DATE") "ca_1", 
  "ta_1"."REGION" "ca_2", 
  CASE WHEN sum("ta_1"."AMOUNT") IS NOT NULL THEN sum("ta_1"."AMOUNT") ELSE 0 END "ca_3"
FROM "ANALYTICS"."PUBLIC"."FCT_ORDERS" "ta_1"
WHERE "ta_1"."REGION" IN ('EMEA', 'AMER')
GROUP BY 
  "ca_1", 
  "ca_2"

SELECT 
  "ta_2"."SEGMENT" "ca_1", 
  CASE WHEN sum("ta_1"."AMOUNT") IS NOT NULL THEN sum("ta_1"."AMOUNT") ELSE 0 END "ca_2"
FROM "ANALYTICS"."PUBLIC"."FCT_ORDERS" "ta_1"
  JOIN "ANALYTICS"."PUBLIC"."DIM_CUSTOMERS" "ta_2"
    ON "ta_1"."CUSTOMER_ID" = "ta_2"."CUSTOMER_ID"
WHERE "ta_1"."REGION" IN ('EMEA', 'AMER')
GROUP BY "ca_1"

SELECT 
  "ta_2"."CUSTOMER_NAME" "ca_1", 
  CASE WHEN sum("ta_1"."AMOUNT") IS NOT NULL THEN sum("ta_1"."AMOUNT") ELSE 0 END "ca_2", 
  count(DISTINCT "ta_1"."ORDER_ID") "ca_3"
FROM "ANALYTICS"."PUBLIC"."FCT_ORDERS" "ta_1"
  JOIN "ANALYTICS"."PUBLIC"."DIM_CUSTOMERS" "ta_2"
    ON "ta_1"."CUSTOMER_ID" = "ta_2"."CUSTOMER_ID"
WHERE "ta_1"."REGION" IN ('EMEA', 'AMER')
GROUP BY "ca_1"
ORDER BY "ca_2" DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  "ta_1"."REGION" "ca_1", 
  (sum("ta_1"."AMOUNT") / sum(sum("ta_1"."AMOUNT")) OVER ()) "ca_2"
FROM "ANALYTICS"."PUBLIC"."FCT_ORDERS" "ta_1"
WHERE "ta_1"."REGION" IN ('EMEA', 'AMER')
GROUP BY "ca_1"
